`13-35`: _🩺 Stability & Availability_ | _🔵 Trivial_ | _⚡ Quick win_ **Check-then-create leaves stale CatalogSource unreconciled.** If `upstream-community-operators` already exists (e.g., created manually or by a prior/different version of this script) with a different `image`/spec, this function silently skips re-applying and just waits on whatever is already there. That can leave Hive being installed against a stale or incorrect catalog without any indication. The sibling pattern in `mirror_utils.sh` (Context snippet 1) always `oc apply`s the manifest unconditionally, which is idempotent and self-healing.
♻️ Suggested fix: always reconcile via apply ```diff function ensure_upstream_community_operators_catalog() { local catalog_namespace="openshift-marketplace" - if ! oc get catalogsource "${HIVE_CATALOG_SOURCE}" -n "${catalog_namespace}" &>/dev/null; then - cat <

In `@deploy/operator/setup_hive.sh` around lines 13 - 35, The ensure_upstream_community_operators_catalog function currently does a check-then-create, which can leave an existing CatalogSource stale if its spec or image changed. Update this function to always reconcile the CatalogSource by applying the manifest unconditionally, similar to the pattern used in mirror_utils.sh, so HIVE_CATALOG_SOURCE in the openshift-marketplace namespace is kept in sync before wait_for_catalogsource runs. ```
--- `40-51`: _📐 Maintainability & Code Quality_ | _🔵 Trivial_ | _💤 Low value_ **Counter-increment idiom is a latent `set -e` landmine.** `((counter++)) && sleep 5` relies on the pre-increment value being non-zero for `&&` to short-circuit correctly under `set -e`. It's safe today only because `counter` is always initialized to `1`, but it's fragile if this loop is ever refactored to start from `0`. Prefer an explicit, non-arithmetic-truthiness-dependent increment.
♻️ Suggested fix ```diff - ((counter++)) && sleep 5 + counter=$((counter + 1)) + sleep 5 ```
